scope: Read-only diagnostic of explicitly authorized existing Windows client. No GUI interaction, logout, data reset, shared product edits or raw log copy.

evidence.panicType: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference

sourceComparison.operation: Reads quoteMessage.Seq after target-conversation db.GetMessage returns an error without a nil guard.

conclusion.confirmed: The logged Go sending-worker panic matches the pinned core nil dereference at api.go:509. The call stack is specific to the Quote branch; ordinary text-forward tests do not exercise it.
conclusion.strongInference: Forwarding a quote/reply into a target conversation that lacks the original quoted clientMsgID makes GetMessage return no quoteMessage, reaching the dereference. Exact message content and recipients were intentionally not extracted.
conclusion.notProven: No authentication, server kick, or SQLite corruption conclusion is established by this diagnostic. Shared-product repair and synthetic reproduction remain owned by root.

repairProposals: Guard nil quoteMessage in pinned Go source and rebuild the matching WASM; retain valid quoted content and set a safe absent-reference sequence.

As a narrowly scoped adapter mitigation, synthetic-test the public sendMessageNotOss path for forwarded Quote messages: its pinned Quote branch serializes quoted content without looking up the original message in the target conversation. Do not route arbitrary media through this method.
Add independent-process regression coverage for a forwarded Quote with a reference absent from the target conversation, checking that subsequent SDK history/group calls remain usable.

privacy.fields: Log metadata, fixed panic type, timestamp, method names and parameter-free stack frames only.
